Name: Perfection Exclusions
Author: rokugin
Description:
[size=3]Perfection Exclusions is a framework meant to be used by mod authors to keep their cooking and crafting recipes from counting towards perfection.

Instructions for how to exclude recipes can be found [url=https://github.com/rokugin/PerfectionExclusions/blob/main/docs/author-guide.md]here[/url].


[img]https://i.ibb.co/2P5VxB3/Perfection-Exclusions-Install.png[/img]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
4. Run the game using SMAPI.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/QXnG2Vy/Perfection-Exclusions-For-Mod-Authors.png[/img]
Edit the custom data asset in any of your existing CP files or create a new one.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/wsn2BSs/Perfection-Exclusions-Compatibility.png[/img]
Likely to cause issues with other mods that change how perfection completion calculation is done.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/nRRTmyC/Perfection-Exclusions-See-Also.png[/img]
[/size][size=3][url=https://github.com/rokugin/PerfectionExclusions]Source[/url][/size][size=3]
[/size]
